about: The secreta of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Graciously accept, O Lord, the offerings we bring for the feast of Your Apostles Philip and James, and ward off all the evils which we deserve. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
